text:
Ana: Heads-up — MarinerHealth saw repeat 503s during their peak window this morning. Ticket INC-4921 opened, customer flagged for SLA exposure.
Sam: saw the alert. error rate jumped to ~6.2% at 10:15 PDT (baseline ~0.2%). 95p latency went 1.2s -> 2.8s.
Maya: confirmed retries from our side increased, looks like KV cache misses correlated with a rolling config push. I rolled back the config at 10:40 and things started to steady.
OpsBot: INC-4921 updated: status -> investigating; priority -> high.
Leo: assigning myself to root cause. I'll pull trace spans for that window and check kernel-level OOMs on the pool.
Ana: customer noted cost bump last week — spend +18% because of retry amplification. They want postmortem + mitigation suggestions before EOD Fri. Renewal touchpoint next week so want to avoid perception issues.
Sam: immediate action items: 1) Leo — collect traces + heap/profile logs (due today EOD). 2) Maya — confirm rollback is fully stable and add a guard to prevent the bad rollout from reapplying (due tomorrow). 3) Ana — update account owner packet and notify AE (due today). 4) Support — send interim note to customer with timeline (Sam).
Maya: guarding config now with a feature flag and a canary check. Adding a preflight script that checks KV hit-rate delta > 15% before apply. snippet: 
```
# preflight
kv_hit_delta=$(calc_hit_rate_delta)
if [ $kv_hit_delta -gt 15 ]; then
  echo "block rollout"
  exit 1
fi
```
Sam: will draft the interim message and share here for quick review. Ana, want me to cc AE and Solutions?
Ana: yes pls cc Jordan (AE) and Priya (Solutions). Add the incident summary + what we rolled back + next steps. Keep tone: apologetic, proactive. :white_check_mark:
Leo: dug into spans — root traces point to a small subset of requests with long KV lookup times hitting a degraded node behind a load balancer. Not full OOMs, but connection saturation on that instance. I opened ENG-2456 to cordon and rebuild the node; will validate KV client reconnect behavior.
Maya: ENG-2456 sounds right. I've added a short-term mitigation: increase client-side retry backoff and reduce parallelism for MarinerHealth's route. That should reduce amplification.
Ana: ownership recap: Leo -> tech RCA + ENG-2456 follow-through. Maya -> rollback guard + client backoff change. Sam -> customer comms + interim update. Ana -> renewal AE loop + account note. OpsBot -> keep INC-4921 updated.
Sam: interim message draft: "Hi team — we saw elevated 503s during your 10:00–11:00 PDT window due to a config rollout that increased KV misses. We rolled back the change and applied mitigations. Engineering is performing a root-cause and we'll share a postmortem by Friday EOD. Apologies for the disruption. — Sam (Redwood)" Thoughts?
Ana: looks good. Add the bit about the short-term backoff change so they know we took concrete steps.
Sam: updated draft and posted to ticket. (link to INC-4921)
Leo: quick note — I may need a dev oncall handoff for the rebuild at 15:00 PDT. Maya, can you cover or should I page infra oncall?
Maya: I can cover the rebuild window, but I'll page infra if we hit unexpected issues.
Ana: scheduling short sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review RCA draft and finalize the postmortem. Please bring logs/graphs and the customer-facing blurb.
Sam: ack. I'll attach error-rate chart and cost delta to the agenda.
OpsBot: Reminder set: incident-review meeting scheduled 2026-03-27T09:30:00Z.
Ana: thanks team. Let's close the loop and keep the AE updated. :thumbsup:
